title: Buriram Marathon 2027 Review: Racing an FIA Grade 1 MotoGP Circuit
meta_description: Buriram Marathon 2027 review: January 23 at Chang International Circuit -- Thailand's FIA Grade 1, MotoGP-hosting racetrack, opened 2014.
dek: Set for 23 January 2027 at Chang International Circuit, this marathon runs on Thailand's premier motorsport venue -- an FIA Grade 1 track that has hosted MotoGP's Thai Grand Prix since 2018.
verdict: The Buriram Marathon offers a genuinely unique course experience: running on Chang International Circuit, an FIA Grade 1-rated, Hermann Tilke-designed racetrack with a 100,000-person capacity that has hosted MotoGP's Thai Grand Prix since 2018 and the World Superbike Championship since 2015. That's a level of purpose-built motorsport infrastructure unmatched by any other race in this entire research batch -- smooth asphalt, professional-grade facilities, and genuine spectator capacity. Two distances (21.1K/42.195K) with registration already open make this an easy, high-value pick for runners who want something genuinely different.

sections.heading: Running on a MotoGP Racetrack
paragraphs: The Buriram Marathon, presented by Chang Mineral, offers two distances -- 21.1K and the 42.195K full marathon -- at Chang International Circuit, Buriram. [1] The circuit is Thailand's premier motorsport venue: FIA Grade 1-rated, designed by Hermann Tilke, with a total capacity of 100,000 (50,000 grandstand plus 50,000 berm), opened in October 2014 at a construction cost of THB 2 billion. [2]

sections.heading: A Track With Real Racing Pedigree
paragraphs: The Grand Prix Circuit runs 4.554km with 12 turns on asphalt surface, hosting the World Superbike Championship since 2015 and MotoGP's Thai Grand Prix since 2018, as well as the Asia Road Racing Championship. [2] The venue was the vision of Thai businessman and politician Newin Chidchob, aimed at developing Buriram as a sports hub -- and running a marathon on this exact tarmac gives participants a genuinely rare experience most road races can't offer.

sections.heading: Purpose-Built Infrastructure
paragraphs: Unlike the city streets, mall parking lots, and beaches hosting most races in this research batch, Chang International Circuit was purpose-engineered for motorsport at the highest professional level -- meaning genuinely smooth, well-maintained surfaces and spectator-grade facilities built directly into the venue. [2]

sections.heading: Marathon and Half Only
paragraphs: Only two distances are offered -- the marathon and half marathon -- with no shorter fun-run category, similar to the Selangor Marathon and Bangsaen42 covered elsewhere in this research. [1] Registration is currently open.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If you want a genuinely unique running experience -- covering ground normally reserved for MotoGP riders and Superbike racers -- the Buriram Marathon on 23 January 2027 is one of the most distinctive venues in this entire research batch. Registration is already open.
